description: The plot illustrates the ASR across various categorical variables under the condition "AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)". The categorical x-axis displays the labels "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics" in sequential order. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, though data points extend slightly beyond this range. Three solid lines represent different conditions. The "start" condition, depicted by a green line with dot markers, begins at approximately 0.77 at "cf", drops to a minimum of roughly 0.49 at "bb", rises to 0.90 at "WNBA", dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily increases to end at its highest value of approximately 0.93 at "athletics". The "random" condition, shown as a brown line with 'x' markers, starts at roughly 0.66 at "cf", decreases to a low of about 0.52 at "bb", increases to 0.87 at "WNBA", drops to 0.72 at "ESPN", trends upward to a peak of approximately 0.93 at "Estadio", and ends at roughly 0.87 at "athletics". The "end" condition, represented by a purple line with circle markers, begins at approximately 0.75 at "cf", falls to a minimum of about 0.57 at "bb", rises to 0.88 at "WNBA", drops to 0.75 at "ESPN", increases to 0.89 at "NHL", dips to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaches its highest peak at approximately 0.97 at "Estadio", and concludes at roughly 0.83 at "athletics".
